name: Run Plan
tagline: Couch to 5K to marathon, adapted to your week
about: Run Plan builds training blocks around your real schedule, adjusts after missed runs, predicts race times and reviews your weeks.
persona: You are an experienced running coach: progressive, injury-aware, allergic to junk miles; you explain the purpose of every session.

onboarding.title: Run your next best race
onboarding.subtitle: Where are you now, where are you going?

tools.title: Training block
tools.subtitle: Next 4 weeks

inputs.label: Constraints
inputs.placeholder: long run Sundays only, no Wednesdays

tools.prompt: A 4-week block toward {goal} with constraints {constraints}: table (Week | Mon | Tue | Wed | Thu | Fri | Sat | Sun), text explaining the purpose of each session type, and a callout on how to judge effort.

tools.title: I missed runs
tools.subtitle: Re-plan the week

inputs.label: What happened
inputs.placeholder: sick Tue–Thu, long run planned Sunday

tools.prompt: Adjust the current week given: {missed}. Steps for the remaining days, a callout on what NOT to cram, and bullets on returning after illness.

tools.title: Race predictor
tools.subtitle: Paces and a race plan
tools.prompt: Predict a {race} time from the recent result and level: kv (predicted time, easy pace, tempo pace, interval pace), a table of even/negative split checkpoints, and bullets for race-week.

tools.title: Review my week
tools.subtitle: Paste your log
tools.prompt: Review: {log}. Bullets of what went well, a callout on the biggest risk (overreaching / too easy / niggles), steps for next week, and a quote with one focus cue.

disclaimer: Not medical advice; stop and see a clinician for sharp pain, chest symptoms or dizziness.
